core.title: Review on Structural Design and Performance Analysis of Wind Turbine Towers
core.abstract: Wind turbine towers are critical supporting structures whose structural safety, durability, and cost-effectiveness become increasingly important as turbine capacities and hub heights increase. This review synthesises the structural design and performance characteristics of steel tubular, concrete, steel–concrete hybrid, and lattice wind turbine towers, with particular emphasis on the role of finite element analysis (FEA). The review considers mechanical behaviour, durability, static response, fatigue performance, and dynamic and seismic characteristics. FEA enables high-fidelity representation of tapered shells, connections, transition sections, material behaviour, and relevant loading conditions, thereby supporting evaluation of stress distributions, deformation, local stress concentrations, buckling resistance, and fatigue-damage accumulation. The reviewed studies indicate that flange connections and transition regions require particular attention in static assessment, while fatigue performance is strongly influenced by cyclic wind loading and tower-specific loading conditions. Modal and seismic analyses further show the importance of natural-frequency control, long-period ground motions, near-field effects, and soil–structure interaction in the dynamic response of wind turbine towers. Emerging approaches combine FEA with machine-learning-based prediction, acoustic-emission monitoring, and vibration-control devices. Overall, FEA provides an effective framework for analysing the principal structural performance aspects of wind turbine towers and for supporting design optimisation, durability assessment, and life-cycle performance evaluation. Future applications may increasingly integrate numerical modelling with digital-twin and structural-health-monitoring approaches.
core.summary: 本文围绕风力机大型化、高塔化背景下的安全、耐久与经济性问题，综述钢管、混凝土、钢—混凝土混合及格构式塔架，重点讨论有限元分析在静力、疲劳、动力与抗震评估中的作用。摘要指出法兰连接、过渡区域及循环风荷载值得关注，并介绍机器学习预测、声发射监测与振动控制的结合趋势。本文适合作为塔架性能研究的入门索引，但当前仅有摘要，不能据此判断综述完整性或模型验证质量。[摘要]

core.abstract: … We present a framework in which a large language model (LLM) acts as an online adaptive controller for SIMP topology optimization, replacing conventional fixed-schedule …
core.summary: 论文研究如何让大语言模型控制结构拓扑优化，而非直接生成结构。内层根据柔顺度、灰度等状态调整四个求解参数，外层跨运行调整控制器规则，并以确定性安全层约束动作。[P4][P11]主要二维、三维实验中，LLM取得最低平均柔顺度，但短预算条件下并非全部最优。[P14][P21][P22]解读：闭环调参架构值得借鉴，但元优化混杂、重启记录缺项及图文矛盾限制了机制归因，不宜把柔顺度改善解释为可靠性提升。

deep_read.problem: 三场SIMP的延续计划决定惩罚、滤波与二值化如何推进。作者认为固定计划不观察当前拓扑，过早锐化可能固化较差局部解，过晚则消耗预算。[P2]研究问题因此不是预测最终结构，而是依据运行状态决定何时、以多大幅度调整求解参数。[P5]
deep_read.method: 内层默认每五次迭代调用Gemini，输出p、β、r_min、δ及重启标志，仍由有限元与OC完成优化。[P9]安全层限制参数范围、滤波半径单调不增，并在G>0.20时强制β≤8；外层根据运行摘要调整控制器常数。四种延续控制器共享40次尾段，固定基线除外。[P11—P13]
deep_read.innovation: 作者提出直接数值控制：LLM不选择预设阶段标签，而是联合给出四参数及审计理由；无需针对拓扑优化训练或微调。[P3]双层架构把运行内决策与跨运行规则调整结合。[P4]解读：价值在工程知识驱动的动态配置，而非新拓扑表示；独立创新性及阶段标签优势仍需更充分对照。
deep_read.findings: 五种主要算例中LLM平均柔顺度最低；二维相对固定改善5.65%、7.46%、7.12%，三维改善18.09%、15.55%。[P14][P21]二维相对专家仅优0.09%—1.92%，且部分耗时更高。[P26]短预算下MBB与L形支架并非最优，说明结果不能推广为所有设置均胜出。[P22]

作者承认仅验证单载荷柔顺度目标，且元优化与在线决策贡献未解耦。[P25]原文件缺项：P16表6续表缺重启执行列，理由不能证实逐次重载。P19灰度门穿越时点与图注矛盾，削弱延迟机制证据。模型版本依赖、冗余重启与API开销也限制复现和部署。[P23][P25]

core.title_zh: 大语言模型作为优化控制器：SIMP拓扑优化的自适应延续

article.lead: 拓扑优化不仅要决定材料放在哪里，还要决定何时让灰色密度变成黑白结构。本文把大语言模型接入SIMP求解循环，根据当前状态直接调整延续参数，在五个主要二维、三维基准上获得最低平均柔顺度。阅读价值不只是性能数字，更在于理解状态反馈、确定性安全层与末端锐化如何共同作用，以及现有消融距离证明“必须使用LLM”还有多远。

sections.title: 锐化时机：黑白结构不等于优质结构
paragraphs: 固定延续日程按迭代编号推进，不知道当前拓扑是否已经充分形成。过早提高Heaviside投影锐度β，可能把较差布局锁定在局部极小值；过晚锐化，则持续消耗预算于灰度材料。本文因此关注单载荷柔顺度最小化中的闭环参数控制，而不是直接预测最终拓扑。
这一问题已有非LLM解决思路。实际检索的《Automatic projection parameter increase for three-field density-based topology optimization》摘要介绍了依据目标变化自动提高β，并配合灰度停止准则和自适应移动限幅的方法。本文值得比较的增量，是同时协调多个参数与重启，而不能把“状态驱动锐化”本身视为独有贡献。

sections.title: LLM提出动作，数值求解器与安全层负责执行
paragraphs: 三场SIMP先将原始密度ρ滤波为ρ̄，再以阈值η=0.5投影为物理密度ρ̃。刚度采用E(ρ̃_e)=E_min+ρ̃_e^p(E_0−E_min)，其中E_min=10^−9E_0；求解KU=F后最小化柔顺度C=FᵀU。设计更新始终采用OC，LLM既不替代有限元，也不输出密度场。
内层默认每5次迭代调用gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview，temperature=0，无拓扑优化数据微调。模型读取柔顺度、灰度、停滞、棋盘格和预算等状态，以JSON直接返回p、β、r_min、δ及restart；解释文本只供审计。确定性安全层裁剪动作，并在G>0.20时强制β≤8，模型无法覆盖。
公式(7)定义G=(4/N_e)Σρ̃_e(1−ρ̃_e)，是连续灰度指标，并非中间密度单元比例。外层在三个二维几何上每个问题执行5次元优化，调整门限、调用频率和阶段常数，不更新模型权重。四个延续控制器均从最佳有效快照执行40次统一锐化尾段，固定基线没有尾段。

sections.title: 五种控制器、五个主基准与两类关键消融
paragraphs: 验证全部来自数值仿真，没有实物制造或力学试验。主要二维悬臂梁、MBB梁、L形支架采用120×60网格，三维悬臂梁和MBB梁采用40×20×10网格，体积分数均为0.40；主循环300次，延续组另加40次尾段。每个问题、每种控制器报告5个随机种子运行，网格单元和API调用均不是独立样本。
比较组包括固定参数、预设三场延续、专家启发式、Schedule-only及LLM。Schedule-only保留四阶段结构，但不读取实际状态；它在二维悬臂梁和MBB梁上分别比固定基线差0.43%和1.09%。另有60×30、100次主循环的Tail-only消融，其从均匀密度执行尾段，柔顺度劣化114.6%–140.5%，说明仅靠锐化不能替代探索。

sections.title: 收益成立，但闭环机制与LLM必要性仍需解耦
paragraphs: 主要二维结果相对固定基线降低柔顺度5.65%、7.46%、7.12%，三维对应降低18.09%、15.55%。但二维相对专家启发式的优势仅为0.09%、1.92%、0.95%，且未报告显著性检验；低预算消融中，LLM也并非三个问题都最优。**较低柔顺度不意味着普遍更快**：二维悬臂梁、MBB梁及两个三维问题均有时间开销。
当前证据支持固定阶段结构不足以解释主实验收益，却不能分离LLM、灰度门、快照重启和外层调参的贡献。三个二维几何都参与元优化，未报告独立测试划分；固定组缺少尾段，也使对它的收益不能全部归因于在线决策。图8门限跨越时间存在图文矛盾，表6缺少重启执行列，MBB密度图还标出G=0.0004，因此应保留精度与机制证据的边界。

routes.title: 用等预算因子实验检验LLM是否不可替代
routes.gap: 现有消融未分离在线LLM、硬灰度门、重启和外层调参，固定基线又没有尾段。建议首先建立可配对的等预算协议，避免将延续收益误认为语言模型的独立贡献。
routes.mechanism: 构建透明的状态反馈规则控制器，依据目标变化、G和停滞调整β与δ，再协调p和滤波半径。检索到的自动投影参数研究可作为机制参考，但目前只有摘要，具体实现需取得全文后确认。
routes.innovation: 候选创新是把LLM决策与同状态、同约束的确定性策略放在统一接口中，分解动作提议和安全层执行的贡献。已有自动锐化机制与这一评测组合须明确区分，不预设LLM必然占优。
routes.design: 建议设计12个几何—载荷配置，4个用于规则调参、8个冻结留出，每组10个配对种子。自行生成并公开网格、载荷和边界条件，不依赖尚未公开的论文仓库；独立配置与种子重复分别统计。
routes.comparison: 设置固定、专家规则、状态反馈规则、LLM及动作轨迹回放组，逐项禁用门控、重启和元优化。统一主循环与尾段，再增加等墙钟预算评测，记录失败回退，不将服务失败排除于主要统计。
routes.criterion: 建议预注册配对柔顺度差及95%置信区间，同时要求体积可行、达到明确灰度容差。只有LLM在留出配置和等时间条件下仍有可靠优势，才支持其额外复杂度；否则优先规则控制器。
routes.risk: 确定性规则可能对调参几何过拟合，API版本也可能漂移。应冻结提示、记录模型版本并保存逐次状态与应用动作；若优势只见于长预算，转向按预算选择控制器，而不追求统一LLM方案。

routes.title: 把参数安全护栏扩展为可验证的求解可信度护栏
routes.gap: 本文护栏主要约束参数范围和灰度，尚不能保证三维线性求解准确或重启理由可信。建议先验证数值状态可信度，再讨论多载荷扩展，不能用低柔顺度替代平衡残差和约束可行性。
routes.mechanism: 在每次参数变化和快照接纳前重算真实残差‖F−KU‖/‖F‖，并核对体积与灰度。实际检索的密度下限研究摘要提示停止残差可能失真，但其FGMRES结果不能直接套用本文AMG预条件CG。
routes.innovation: 候选创新是将残差验收、动作冲突标记和受限重启统一为独立监督层，LLM只提出动作。真实残差守卫属于已有技术；与延续决策审计的耦合及其成本收益才是需要实验检验的新组合。
routes.design: 建议设计8个三维配置，各采集20个不同演化阶段的冻结状态，另作每配置10个种子闭环运行。数据需由可公开的自建有限元流程生成，分别保留状态测试与完整轨迹，不混计为独立几何。
routes.comparison: 比较原安全层、增加残差守卫、增加阈值显式观测、限制晚期重启四组，使用相同求解容差。再与确定性可信度控制器比较，消融残差检查和理由冲突标记，并注入可记录的API失败。
routes.criterion: 建议以全部接纳状态满足预设残差容差为首要判据，同时报告错误接纳率、无效重启数、柔顺度和墙钟开销。阈值如10^−6仅为建议起点，需经网格与求解器敏感性分析确定。
routes.risk: 额外残差检查可能抵消优化收益，故先测试冻结状态再进入闭环。若检查昂贵，可按参数突变和停滞触发，但最终状态仍须强制验收；若多载荷成本过高，先限制在单载荷验证可信度。

core.title: CE-MAC: Cloud–Edge Multiagent Collaboration for Adaptive Model Pruning
core.abstract: Deploying high accuracy models on resource-limited edge is essential for industrial applications, yet challenging due to the diverse and dynamic real-world environment. Cloud–edge collaboration helps by training high-capacity models in the cloud and deploying compressed models to edge nodes. However, traditional pipelines assume a fixed setting and lack the flexibility to adapt compression strategies to the heterogeneous and evolving environment. To overcome this, we propose CE-MAC, a cloud–edge collaborative large language model (LLM)-based multiagent system (LLM-MAS) for adaptive edge model compression. We adopt model pruning for its support of customizable and progressive compression, enabling flexible adaptation in dynamic edge environments. The LLM-MAS acts as the decision hub, generating device-specific pruning policies based on real-time feedback from both cloud and edge, enabling better cloud–edge co-evolution. We evaluate CE-MAC on image classification, keyword spotting, bearing fault diagnosis, and electricity theft detection tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance across heterogeneous data and varying compression levels.

core.title: Thermally Recoverable Fracto‐Mechanoluminescence in Manganese‐Based Hybrid Halides for Fatigue‐Resistant Structural Health Monitoring
core.abstract: ABSTRACT Fracto‐mechanoluminescence (FML) materials have recently demonstrated great potential as next‐generation interactive optoelectronic systems, while they generally suffer from irreversible fatigue degradation under long‐term cyclic stress, severely limiting their practical applications. Here we design the flexible FML composite films based on the manganese‐based hybrid halide EPB 2 MnBr 4 (EPB = ethyltriphenylphosphonium), exhibiting intense green emission under mechanical stimuli. Notably, the FML intensity that degrades after repeated mechanical cycles can be effectively recovered to approximately 75.5% of its original value through thermal treatment, which can be attributed to Ostwald ripening within the used resin matrix. Furthermore, a one‐dimensional convolutional neural network has been developed to classify mechanical events based on FML signals for structural health monitoring in mining, achieving 98.75% accuracy across four mechanical events and demonstrating the pattern‐recognition capability of machine learning. This work establishes a Mn‐based hybrid halide FML device with thermal recovery capability, providing new strategies for designing fatigue‐resistant sensing materials and demonstrating potential for structural health monitoring.

extended.abstract: The dataset used in this research is a well-curated collection of aluminum and titanium alloy samples, compiled from experimentally reported values and reliable literature sources for UAV structural applications. The dataset created using this methodology can simulate engineering practices that use common material systems found in aerospace structures. The dataset provides a comprehensive evaluation of material properties by integrating information from various sources to capture genuine physical, mechanical, fatigue, and operational properties. The study emphasizes the variety of material attributes and the engineering importance of the attributes selected, because these factors determine the accuracy of modeling UAV material selection within a complex multi-criteria system. Each sample's material description includes 12 attributes: density, Young's modulus, yield strength, ultimate tensile strength, fatigue strength, fatigue life, hardness, corrosion resistance, weldability, cost level, and availability. The machine learning models consider both quantitative and qualitative parameters to examine how design requirements interact in nonlinear ways. The selected aluminum and titanium alloys were chosen for this study because they frequently appear in UAV systems, which establishes the dataset as both a theoretical and practical research foundation. The developed machine learning models show improved reliability and generalization, and they provide engineering value for UAV structural design and material selection.

extended.title: Zero-Shot Open Circuit Fault Diagnosis of Converter Based on Prior-Knowledge Injected Dual Bayesian Network With Attention Mechanism
extended.venue: IEEE transactions on industrial electronics (1982. Print)
extended.abstract: Power electronic systems serve as core infrastructure for modern energy conversion and power control. Their reliability is crucial for the stable operation of key fields, such as industrial power systems, transportation, and aerospace. Open-circuit faults are difficult to detect, which can lead to serious consequences. While effective in data-rich environments, existing data-driven approaches’ reliance on extensive labeled data hinders their practical deployment. The reason is that acquiring comprehensive fault data in real-world settings is often prohibitively expensive. To address this, this article proposes a dual Bayesian zero-shot fault diagnosis approach based on prior-knowledge injected with attention mechanism (PKIDBAAM). This approach constructs a fault attribute space with clear physical meaning by analyzing the physical relationship between the Vienna rectifier topology and fault modes. It employs a multihead attention mechanism to dynamically fuse multidomain fault features from three-phase current signals. A dual Bayesian inference framework combining naive Bayes and integrated multiple Gaussian Bayesian algorithms is designed to achieve high accuracy recognition of inaccessible open-circuit faults. extended.title: Predictive Models of Fatigue Failure in Steel Bridges under Severe Dynamic Loading: An Advanced Fracture-Mechanics, Probabilistic, and Digital-Twin Framework
extended.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
extended.abstract: Sudden failures of steel bridges are frequently associated with fatigue cracks that initiate at welded joints, geometric discontinuities, bolted connections, orthotropic decks, diaphragm attachments, and corrosion-damaged regions. Although fatigue failure is usually a progressive phenomenon, its final stage can occur abruptly when a subcritical crack reaches a critical size and the stress-intensity factor exceeds the fracture toughness of the material. Under high dynamic loading, the conventional static stress-range approach may be insufficient because structural inertia, resonance, traffic-induced vibration, impact effects, mixed-mode fracture, corrosion, residual stress, and uncertainty in the actual load spectrum interact simultaneously.This paper develops an advanced predictive framework for steel-bridge fatigue failure based on the coupling of structural dynamics, elastic and elastic–plastic fracture mechanics, stochastic traffic loading, probabilistic reliability, sensor-based condition assessment, and digital-twin technology. The central mathematical model combines the dynamic equation of motion, rainflow-derived stress spectra, nonlinear fatigue damage accumulation, crack-growth laws based on the Paris–Erdogan and Forman equations, and a limit-state reliability function. The proposed framework further incorporates Bayesian updating and physics-informed machine learning to reduce uncertainty using strain gauges, accelerometers, acoustic-emission sensors, weigh-in-motion systems, and machine-vision inspection. The most reliable fatigue-prediction technology is not a single predictive algorithm but a multi-layered system combining mechanics-based analysis, continuous monitoring, probabilistic inference, and conservative maintenance decision-making.

papers.title: Review on Structural Design and Performance Analysis of Wind Turbine Towers
papers.abstract: Wind turbine towers are critical supporting structures whose structural safety, durability, and cost-effectiveness become increasingly important as turbine capacities and hub heights increase. This review synthesises the structural design and performance characteristics of steel tubular, concrete, steel–concrete hybrid, and lattice wind turbine towers, with particular emphasis on the role of finite element analysis (FEA). The review considers mechanical behaviour, durability, static response, fatigue performance, and dynamic and seismic characteristics. FEA enables high-fidelity representation of tapered shells, connections, transition sections, material behaviour, and relevant loading conditions, thereby supporting evaluation of stress distributions, deformation, local stress concentrations, buckling resistance, and fatigue-damage accumulation. The reviewed studies indicate that flange connections and transition regions require particular attention in static assessment, while fatigue performance is strongly influenced by cyclic wind loading and tower-specific loading conditions. Modal and seismic analyses further show the importance of natural-frequency control, long-period ground motions, near-field effects, and soil–structure interaction in the dynamic response of wind turbine towers. Emerging approaches combine FEA with machine-learning-based prediction, acoustic-emission monitoring, and vibration-control devices. Overall, FEA provides an effective framework for analysing the principal structural performance aspects of wind turbine towers and for supporting design optimisation, durability assessment, and life-cycle performance evaluation. Future applications may increasingly integrate numerical modelling with digital-twin and structural-health-monitoring approaches.

deep_read.innovation: 解读：其潜在价值在于将多类塔架及静力、疲劳、动力问题置于共同的有限元分析框架下，而非提出已获验证的新算法。摘要提及“machine-learning-based prediction”等融合方向，但未证明这些方法由本文首创，也未提供足以判定原创性的比较证据。[摘要]
deep_read.findings: 综述归纳认为，静力评估应关注“flange connections and transition regions”，疲劳则受循环风荷载与塔架特定荷载条件显著影响。动力与抗震分析还需考虑固有频率控制、长周期地震动、近场效应及土—结构相互作用；摘要未报告定量比较结果。[摘要]
deep_read.limitations: 当前证据仅限摘要，缺少文献筛选流程、研究覆盖范围、模型验证资料及不确定性处理信息，因此无法核实综述的系统性与结论稳健性。“high-fidelity representation”是摘要对有限元能力的表述，并不能替代具体误差验证；这些是资料限制，不是已确认的论文缺陷。[摘要]
deep_read.connection: 解读：与结构设计的联系最直接，包括应力、变形与屈曲评估；与可靠性研究的联系来自“fatigue-damage accumulation”，但尚无概率可靠性证据。机器学习及监测提供智能运维线索；摘要未涉及生成式设计机制，不能将一般设计优化等同于生成式设计。[摘要]
deep_read.next_steps: 建议：后续获取全文时，优先核查连接与过渡段的建模假设、疲劳荷载谱及验证依据，并追踪监测与数值模型融合的具体案例。可探索用监测信息更新有限元模型并评估寿命预测不确定性；该设想受“digital-twin”展望启发，不是本文已完成的成果。[摘要]

papers.title_zh: 大语言模型作为优化控制器：SIMP拓扑优化的自适应延续

article.lead: 拓扑优化不仅要决定材料放在哪里，还要决定何时让灰色密度变成黑白结构。本文把大语言模型接入SIMP求解循环，根据当前状态直接调整延续参数，在五个主要二维、三维基准上获得最低平均柔顺度。阅读价值不只是性能数字，更在于理解状态反馈、确定性安全层与末端锐化如何共同作用，以及现有消融距离证明“必须使用LLM”还有多远。

sections.title: 锐化时机：黑白结构不等于优质结构
paragraphs: 固定延续日程按迭代编号推进，不知道当前拓扑是否已经充分形成。过早提高Heaviside投影锐度β，可能把较差布局锁定在局部极小值；过晚锐化，则持续消耗预算于灰度材料。本文因此关注单载荷柔顺度最小化中的闭环参数控制，而不是直接预测最终拓扑。
这一问题已有非LLM解决思路。实际检索的《Automatic projection parameter increase for three-field density-based topology optimization》摘要介绍了依据目标变化自动提高β，并配合灰度停止准则和自适应移动限幅的方法。本文值得比较的增量，是同时协调多个参数与重启，而不能把“状态驱动锐化”本身视为独有贡献。

sections.title: LLM提出动作，数值求解器与安全层负责执行
paragraphs: 三场SIMP先将原始密度ρ滤波为ρ̄，再以阈值η=0.5投影为物理密度ρ̃。刚度采用E(ρ̃_e)=E_min+ρ̃_e^p(E_0−E_min)，其中E_min=10^−9E_0；求解KU=F后最小化柔顺度C=FᵀU。设计更新始终采用OC，LLM既不替代有限元，也不输出密度场。
内层默认每5次迭代调用gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview，temperature=0，无拓扑优化数据微调。模型读取柔顺度、灰度、停滞、棋盘格和预算等状态，以JSON直接返回p、β、r_min、δ及restart；解释文本只供审计。确定性安全层裁剪动作，并在G>0.20时强制β≤8，模型无法覆盖。
公式(7)定义G=(4/N_e)Σρ̃_e(1−ρ̃_e)，是连续灰度指标，并非中间密度单元比例。外层在三个二维几何上每个问题执行5次元优化，调整门限、调用频率和阶段常数，不更新模型权重。四个延续控制器均从最佳有效快照执行40次统一锐化尾段，固定基线没有尾段。

sections.title: 五种控制器、五个主基准与两类关键消融
paragraphs: 验证全部来自数值仿真，没有实物制造或力学试验。主要二维悬臂梁、MBB梁、L形支架采用120×60网格，三维悬臂梁和MBB梁采用40×20×10网格，体积分数均为0.40；主循环300次，延续组另加40次尾段。每个问题、每种控制器报告5个随机种子运行，网格单元和API调用均不是独立样本。
比较组包括固定参数、预设三场延续、专家启发式、Schedule-only及LLM。Schedule-only保留四阶段结构，但不读取实际状态；它在二维悬臂梁和MBB梁上分别比固定基线差0.43%和1.09%。另有60×30、100次主循环的Tail-only消融，其从均匀密度执行尾段，柔顺度劣化114.6%–140.5%，说明仅靠锐化不能替代探索。

sections.title: 收益成立，但闭环机制与LLM必要性仍需解耦
paragraphs: 主要二维结果相对固定基线降低柔顺度5.65%、7.46%、7.12%，三维对应降低18.09%、15.55%。但二维相对专家启发式的优势仅为0.09%、1.92%、0.95%，且未报告显著性检验；低预算消融中，LLM也并非三个问题都最优。**较低柔顺度不意味着普遍更快**：二维悬臂梁、MBB梁及两个三维问题均有时间开销。
当前证据支持固定阶段结构不足以解释主实验收益，却不能分离LLM、灰度门、快照重启和外层调参的贡献。三个二维几何都参与元优化，未报告独立测试划分；固定组缺少尾段，也使对它的收益不能全部归因于在线决策。图8门限跨越时间存在图文矛盾，表6缺少重启执行列，MBB密度图还标出G=0.0004，因此应保留精度与机制证据的边界。

experiments.name: 二维主基准五控制器比较及Schedule-only消融
experiments.data: 悬臂梁、MBB梁、L形支架数值基准；120×60网格，V_f=0.40、ν=0.3、E_min/E_0=10^−9。
experiments.samples: 每个问题、每个控制器n=5个独立随机种子运行；三种几何不等于15个独立结构。未报告实物试件或增强数据数量。
experiments.groups: 五组分别为Fixed、三场延续、专家启发式、Schedule-only、LLM；主循环300次，除Fixed外追加40次统一尾段。
experiments.split: 无需训练或微调；三个二维几何均参与外层调参。未报告训练、验证、测试划分或独立留出几何。
experiments.baselines: Fixed保持p=3、β=1、r_min=1.5、δ=0.2；另比较预设延续、专家规则及无状态反馈的四阶段调度。
experiments.metrics: 柔顺度C=FᵀU及均值±标准差、灰度G、相对Fixed均值变化、墙钟时间和最佳快照迭代数；C单位未报告。
experiments.limitations: Fixed无尾段，处理预算不同；未报告显著性检验。正文最小非零标准差表述与表值不符，G=0.000也须结合图中精度解释。

routes.title: 用等预算因子实验检验LLM是否不可替代
routes.gap: 现有消融未分离在线LLM、硬灰度门、重启和外层调参，固定基线又没有尾段。建议首先建立可配对的等预算协议，避免将延续收益误认为语言模型的独立贡献。
routes.mechanism: 构建透明的状态反馈规则控制器，依据目标变化、G和停滞调整β与δ，再协调p和滤波半径。检索到的自动投影参数研究可作为机制参考，但目前只有摘要，具体实现需取得全文后确认。
routes.innovation: 候选创新是把LLM决策与同状态、同约束的确定性策略放在统一接口中，分解动作提议和安全层执行的贡献。已有自动锐化机制与这一评测组合须明确区分，不预设LLM必然占优。
routes.design: 建议设计12个几何—载荷配置，4个用于规则调参、8个冻结留出，每组10个配对种子。自行生成并公开网格、载荷和边界条件，不依赖尚未公开的论文仓库；独立配置与种子重复分别统计。
routes.comparison: 设置固定、专家规则、状态反馈规则、LLM及动作轨迹回放组，逐项禁用门控、重启和元优化。统一主循环与尾段，再增加等墙钟预算评测，记录失败回退，不将服务失败排除于主要统计。
routes.criterion: 建议预注册配对柔顺度差及95%置信区间，同时要求体积可行、达到明确灰度容差。只有LLM在留出配置和等时间条件下仍有可靠优势，才支持其额外复杂度；否则优先规则控制器。
routes.risk: 确定性规则可能对调参几何过拟合，API版本也可能漂移。应冻结提示、记录模型版本并保存逐次状态与应用动作；若优势只见于长预算，转向按预算选择控制器，而不追求统一LLM方案。

routes.title: 把参数安全护栏扩展为可验证的求解可信度护栏
routes.gap: 本文护栏主要约束参数范围和灰度，尚不能保证三维线性求解准确或重启理由可信。建议先验证数值状态可信度，再讨论多载荷扩展，不能用低柔顺度替代平衡残差和约束可行性。
routes.mechanism: 在每次参数变化和快照接纳前重算真实残差‖F−KU‖/‖F‖，并核对体积与灰度。实际检索的密度下限研究摘要提示停止残差可能失真，但其FGMRES结果不能直接套用本文AMG预条件CG。
routes.innovation: 候选创新是将残差验收、动作冲突标记和受限重启统一为独立监督层，LLM只提出动作。真实残差守卫属于已有技术；与延续决策审计的耦合及其成本收益才是需要实验检验的新组合。
routes.design: 建议设计8个三维配置，各采集20个不同演化阶段的冻结状态，另作每配置10个种子闭环运行。数据需由可公开的自建有限元流程生成，分别保留状态测试与完整轨迹，不混计为独立几何。
routes.comparison: 比较原安全层、增加残差守卫、增加阈值显式观测、限制晚期重启四组，使用相同求解容差。再与确定性可信度控制器比较，消融残差检查和理由冲突标记，并注入可记录的API失败。
routes.criterion: 建议以全部接纳状态满足预设残差容差为首要判据，同时报告错误接纳率、无效重启数、柔顺度和墙钟开销。阈值如10^−6仅为建议起点，需经网格与求解器敏感性分析确定。
routes.risk: 额外残差检查可能抵消优化收益，故先测试冻结状态再进入闭环。若检查昂贵，可按参数突变和停滞触发，但最终状态仍须强制验收；若多载荷成本过高，先限制在单载荷验证可信度。

papers.title: CE-MAC: Cloud–Edge Multiagent Collaboration for Adaptive Model Pruning
papers.abstract: Deploying high accuracy models on resource-limited edge is essential for industrial applications, yet challenging due to the diverse and dynamic real-world environment. Cloud–edge collaboration helps by training high-capacity models in the cloud and deploying compressed models to edge nodes. However, traditional pipelines assume a fixed setting and lack the flexibility to adapt compression strategies to the heterogeneous and evolving environment. To overcome this, we propose CE-MAC, a cloud–edge collaborative large language model (LLM)-based multiagent system (LLM-MAS) for adaptive edge model compression. We adopt model pruning for its support of customizable and progressive compression, enabling flexible adaptation in dynamic edge environments. The LLM-MAS acts as the decision hub, generating device-specific pruning policies based on real-time feedback from both cloud and edge, enabling better cloud–edge co-evolution. We evaluate CE-MAC on image classification, keyword spotting, bearing fault diagnosis, and electricity theft detection tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance across heterogeneous data and varying compression levels.
papers.summary: 工业边缘设备资源受限，且设备条件与实际环境不断变化，固定压缩策略难以持续适配。本文提出CE-MAC，以基于大语言模型的多智能体系统作为决策中心，结合云端与边缘实时反馈，生成设备专属剪枝策略。摘要报告在图像分类、关键词识别、轴承故障诊断和窃电检测任务上取得先进性能，但未提供具体指标、对照与成本数据。解读：其阅读价值在于压缩决策的动态协作机制；当前仅能进行摘要级判断。[摘要]

deep_read.limitations: 当前证据局限来自摘要信息不足，并非已证实的方法缺陷。资料没有说明大语言模型决策开销、云边通信需求、剪枝后的精度变化及异常反馈处理方式，也未呈现消融实验。解读：这些缺口限制了对实际部署收益、决策可靠性与性能优势来源的评估。[摘要]

papers.title: Thermally Recoverable Fracto‐Mechanoluminescence in Manganese‐Based Hybrid Halides for Fatigue‐Resistant Structural Health Monitoring
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Fracto‐mechanoluminescence (FML) materials have recently demonstrated great potential as next‐generation interactive optoelectronic systems, while they generally suffer from irreversible fatigue degradation under long‐term cyclic stress, severely limiting their practical applications. Here we design the flexible FML composite films based on the manganese‐based hybrid halide EPB 2 MnBr 4 (EPB = ethyltriphenylphosphonium), exhibiting intense green emission under mechanical stimuli. Notably, the FML intensity that degrades after repeated mechanical cycles can be effectively recovered to approximately 75.5% of its original value through thermal treatment, which can be attributed to Ostwald ripening within the used resin matrix. Furthermore, a one‐dimensional convolutional neural network has been developed to classify mechanical events based on FML signals for structural health monitoring in mining, achieving 98.75% accuracy across four mechanical events and demonstrating the pattern‐recognition capability of machine learning. This work establishes a Mn‐based hybrid halide FML device with thermal recovery capability, providing new strategies for designing fatigue‐resistant sensing materials and demonstrating potential for structural health monitoring.

papers.title: Zero-Shot Open Circuit Fault Diagnosis of Converter Based on Prior-Knowledge Injected Dual Bayesian Network With Attention Mechanism
papers.venue: IEEE transactions on industrial electronics (1982. Print)
papers.abstract: Power electronic systems serve as core infrastructure for modern energy conversion and power control. Their reliability is crucial for the stable operation of key fields, such as industrial power systems, transportation, and aerospace. Open-circuit faults are difficult to detect, which can lead to serious consequences. While effective in data-rich environments, existing data-driven approaches’ reliance on extensive labeled data hinders their practical deployment. The reason is that acquiring comprehensive fault data in real-world settings is often prohibitively expensive. To address this, this article proposes a dual Bayesian zero-shot fault diagnosis approach based on prior-knowledge injected with attention mechanism (PKIDBAAM). This approach constructs a fault attribute space with clear physical meaning by analyzing the physical relationship between the Vienna rectifier topology and fault modes. It employs a multihead attention mechanism to dynamically fuse multidomain fault features from three-phase current signals. A dual Bayesian inference framework combining naive Bayes and integrated multiple Gaussian Bayesian algorithms is designed to achieve high accuracy recognition of inaccessible open-circuit faults. The verification results on a Vienna rectifier experimental platform show that it significantly outperforms conventional classical machine learning models, which provides a new solution for intelligent fault diagnosis in power electronic systems.

papers.title: Predictive Models of Fatigue Failure in Steel Bridges under Severe Dynamic Loading: An Advanced Fracture-Mechanics, Probabilistic, and Digital-Twin Framework
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Sudden failures of steel bridges are frequently associated with fatigue cracks that initiate at welded joints, geometric discontinuities, bolted connections, orthotropic decks, diaphragm attachments, and corrosion-damaged regions. Although fatigue failure is usually a progressive phenomenon, its final stage can occur abruptly when a subcritical crack reaches a critical size and the stress-intensity factor exceeds the fracture toughness of the material. Under high dynamic loading, the conventional static stress-range approach may be insufficient because structural inertia, resonance, traffic-induced vibration, impact effects, mixed-mode fracture, corrosion, residual stress, and uncertainty in the actual load spectrum interact simultaneously.This paper develops an advanced predictive framework for steel-bridge fatigue failure based on the coupling of structural dynamics, elastic and elastic–plastic fracture mechanics, stochastic traffic loading, probabilistic reliability, sensor-based condition assessment, and digital-twin technology. The central mathematical model combines the dynamic equation of motion, rainflow-derived stress spectra, nonlinear fatigue damage accumulation, crack-growth laws based on the Paris–Erdogan and Forman equations, and a limit-state reliability function. The proposed framework further incorporates Bayesian updating and physics-informed machine learning to reduce uncertainty using strain gauges, accelerometers, acoustic-emission sensors, weigh-in-motion systems, and machine-vision inspection. The most reliable fatigue-prediction technology is not a single predictive algorithm but a multi-layered system combining mechanics-based analysis, continuous monitoring, probabilistic inference, and conservative maintenance decision-making.

deep_read.innovation: 解读：摘要呈现的潜在特色是将动力响应、裂纹演化、概率推断与数字孪生纳入同一预测体系，而非只估算疲劳寿命。不过，“advanced predictive framework”属于作者对框架的定位；缺少既有方法对比，不能确认各模块或其耦合具有原创性。[摘要]
deep_read.findings: 摘要主张可靠预测应依靠多层系统，结合力学分析、连续监测、概率推断与保守维护决策，并强调“not a single predictive algorithm”。这属于方法论结论；当前资料未报告试验、案例、误差指标或可靠性改善幅度，不能当作已验证的性能成果。[摘要]
deep_read.limitations: 当前资料只有摘要，未说明桥型、材料参数、荷载数据、裂纹观测与验证方案，也未报告不确定性降低的量化结果。因此无法判断框架的适用边界、计算成本及现场实施条件。这些是现有资料的证据缺口，不应直接认定为作者研究本身已证实的缺陷。[摘要]
deep_read.connection: 解读：该框架与智能运维和疲劳可靠性方向直接相关：应变、加速度、声发射、动态称重及机器视觉数据可参与状态评估，概率模型连接裂纹风险与维护决策。对结构设计的联系则较间接，摘要未提供构造优化、尺寸设计或设计规范层面的成果。[摘要]
deep_read.next_steps: 建议：后续阅读应核对动态应力谱如何驱动裂纹模型、监测数据如何更新参数，以及极限状态如何对应维护阈值。若开展迁移研究，可先选明确疲劳细节，对比静态模型与耦合模型的预测和不确定性；这些是研究建议，并非摘要已完成的工作。[摘要]
